import importlib.util, json
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m', '/workspace/submission/main.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

def run(req):
    return json.loads(m.process(json.dumps(req).encode()))

# hand-computed: L = words ending with 'aa'
out = run({'services': ['a','b'],
           'rules': [{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'endswith','path':['a','a']}}],
           'queries': [['a'],['a','a'],['b','a','a'],['a','a','a'],['b']]})
d = out['dfa']
print('endswith aa:', d['accept'], d['next'], d['distance'])
print('  queries:', out['queries'])

# hand-computed: L = {a} exactly
out = run({'services': ['a','b'],
           'rules': [{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'match','path':['a']}}],
           'queries': [[],['a'],['b'],['a','a']]})
d = out['dfa']
print('match a:', d['accept'], d['next'], d['distance'])
print('  queries:', out['queries'])

# L = words starting with 'a' minus words containing 'b'
out = run({'services': ['a','b'],
           'rules': [{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'startswith','path':['a']}},
                     {'action':'drop','when':{'op':'contains','path':['b']}}],
           'queries': [['a'],['a','a'],['b'],['a','b']]})
d = out['dfa']
print('startswith a minus contains b:', d['accept'], d['next'], d['distance'])

# L = Sigma* (allow true)
out = run({'services': ['a','b'], 'rules': [{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'true'}}], 'queries': [['a','b','a']]})
print('all words:', out['dfa'])

# negation: not contains ['a','a']
out = run({'services': ['a','b'],
           'rules': [{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'not','arg':{'op':'contains','path':['a','a']}}}],
           'queries': [['a'],['a','a'],['b'],['a','b','a']]})
d = out['dfa']
print('avoid aa:', d['accept'], d['next'], d['distance'])
print('  queries:', out['queries'])
